minimap.structuralCliffAuthority: same baked continuous-surface StructuralCellV2 cache used by runtime cliff rendering/collision
minimap.routeVisibility: Road, MountainPath, StonePath, Bridge and river semantics share world-map code priority

worldMap.terrainAuthority: persistent granular exploration cells sampled from actual loaded scene maps plus live baked structural cache
worldMap.finiteWorldBehavior: show only cells revealed within the player discovery radius; explored bounds grow continuously rather than one storage partition at a time
worldMap.endlessWorldBehavior: same granular discovery-backed global tile map; exploration extends indefinitely as the player travels
worldMap.sampleResolution: 2x2 world tiles per map cell; reveal radius 20 tiles; unrevealed cells are not drawn
worldMap.routeVisibility: Road, MountainPath, StonePath, Bridge and river cells are captured from actual explored scene data
worldMap.cliffVisibility: cliff marks come only from the same baked StructuralCellV2/CliffShape15 cache used by runtime cliff rendering; local raw-level inference is forbidden
worldMap.streamingSynchronization: newly loaded, hydrology-reconciled, or activated surface partitions rebuild the continuous structural cache before map capture

nonGoals: No generated or replacement flora artwork
No waypoint or route persistence in this pass
No minimap rotation in this pass
No waypoint or route-planning UI in this pass; only route visibility is implemented
